title: Exact solution for stationary states of a closed memristor with mobile charged vacancies
summary: A nonlinear model of a memristor based on charged mobile vacancies is considered taking into account the electrostatic interaction between them. This interaction significantly affects the stationary (limiting) vacancy distributions formed under the action of the electric current flowing through the memristor, for which analytical expressions are obtained in this work. Between the regions with reduced and increased vacancy concentrations, an intermediate electrically neutral region is formed due to the electrostatic interaction.
